descricao_original: Stages in telophase are shown in these images. During telophase, the chromosomes are completely segregated into the eventual daughter cells and begin to decondense. At the same time, the nuclear envelope reforms and the cell completes cytokinesis. Whitefish blastula, 1500x

bases.legenda_ia: Imagem-base educacional de histologia da pagina 'Telophase', no setor Células > Divisão Celular > Mitose > Light Micrographs > Mitosis light micrographs 9. Descricao original da pagina: Stages in telophase are shown in these images. During telophase, the chromosomes are completely segregated into the eventual daughter cells and begin to decondense. At the same time, the nuclear envelope reforms and the cell completes cytokinesis. Whitefish blastula, 1500x.
